  • Building demanding products on Open Source foundations for decades
  • Open Source advocate and notable author since the 1990s, e.g. I wrote unittest.py for the Python standard library around 2000
  • Contributed to many hundreds (!) of repositories in various languages
  • Was in the top 100 most active GitHub developers worldwide for several years
  • Largely built up an open source community project from an early prototype to having thousands of contributors and 0.3B downloads
  • Many thousands of followers here and on social media, and many supporters on Patreon

Beyond Open Source, I'm a joyful product-and-team-first startup veteran and founder across many industry sectors, as well as an experienced and popular people leader, programming language nerd, consultant and freelancer.

In recent years I've alternated between hands-on technical direction of challenging projects (Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer), and growing/nurturing technical orgs of 60-90 engineers (VP Eng, Senior Director).

I'm occasionally available for hire, so feel free to get in touch.
